title: RunnerClaim
description: 200 answer to POST /api/runners/claim: the job this runner now holds. 'reattached': the runner already held it (it restarted) and gets it back.

quality.description: Quality to train at ('draft' for kinds that do not train).

leaseSeconds.description: The lease; every progress call renews it.

bundleSha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the bundle; the runner checks it after the download.

previews.description: The server takes intermediate splats (PUT .../preview). Only ever true for 'splat'.

wallId.description: For the runner's local status page only (ids, never names).

kind.description: Absent on servers from before textures jobs: 'splat'.

requiredMemoryMb.description: Memory the job needs on the runner, MB: textures (against texturesMemoryMb), splat-prepare / splat-finish (against memoryBudgetMb; 6144 / 3072 by default). Null when the kind has no memory gate.

quality.description: Splat quality profile, lowest to highest.

kind.description: The job kind; equal to the capability that lets a runner claim it. 'splat-prepare' / 'splat-finish' (runner protocol 1.1) have a runner envelope as bundle and result.
